info.name: Hospital API - Tarea 014
info.description: Colección manual ordenada para validar la API en http://localhost:3000. Usa variables dinámicas, verifica HTTP/DTO y elimina los registros temporales al terminar. El header x-user-role es una simulación educativa e insegura. No contiene credenciales reales. IMPORTANTE: ejecutar carpetas y requests en orden completo con Runner; la base debe tener especialidades sembradas.

exec: let d1 = doc(); let d2 = doc(); while (d1 === d2) d2 = doc();

pm.test("Incluye 3 citas nuevas", () => { const ids = body.data.map(x => String(x.id)); ["appointment1Id", "appointment2Id", "appointment3Id"].forEach(k => pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get(k))); });

pm.test("Dos citas del paciente 1", () => { const ids = body.data.map(x=>String(x.id)); pm.expect(ids).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment1Id"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment2Id"))); pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment3Id"))); });

pm.test("Dos citas del médico 1", () => { const ids=body.data.map(x=>String(x.id)); pm.expect(ids).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment1Id"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment2Id"))); pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment3Id"))); });
pm.test("Todas las citas son de la fecha pedida", () => pm.expect(body.data.every(x=>x.date==="2026-11-20")).to.equal(true));

pm.test("Filtrado combinado incluye solo cita 1", () => { const ids=body.data.map(x=>String(x.id)); pm.expect(ids).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment1Id"))); pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment2Id"))); pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("appointment3Id"))); });
